features: Unlimited remote support
Raise a ticket or pick up the phone — we'll sort it fast with no call limits and no hidden charges.
Proactive monitoring
We watch your devices around the clock and deal with issues before they become problems.
Automated OS patching
Windows, Mac and server updates applied automatically — keeping your devices secure and up to date.
Third-party application patching
We patch your software too — not just the operating system — so nothing gets left vulnerable.
Endpoint security
Industry-leading antivirus and threat detection deployed and managed across all your devices.
Remote device management
We manage your entire device estate remotely — no need for an on-site visit for the majority of issues.
Microsoft 365 support
Email, Teams, OneDrive and the full Microsoft 365 suite — we keep it running and sort any issues quickly.
New user & device setup
New member of staff? We'll get them set up and ready to go — laptop, email, access and all.
No long-term contracts
We start on simple monthly rolling agreements — no lock-in, no lengthy commitments.
Fixed monthly pricing
One simple price per user per month — no surprise bills, no call-out charges, no hidden costs.
